```{r}
library(splines)
library(ggplot2)
library(mgcv)
```

```{r}
# reikia pridėti ieškojimą geriausio df
spline_model <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ bs(ProductRelated, df = 5), data = df)

summary(spline_model)
```

```{r}
ns_model <- lm(ProductRelated_Duration ~ ns(ProductRelated, df = 5), data = df)

summary(ns_model)
```



```{r}
gam_model <- gam(ProductRelated_Duration ~ s(ProductRelated) + s(Administrative) + 
                 s(PageValues) + VisitorType + Weekend, 
                 data = df, method = "REML")

summary(gam_model)
```


```{r}
termplot(spline_model, partial.resid = TRUE, se = TRUE, main = "B-Spline")
termplot(ns_model, partial.resid = TRUE, se = TRUE, main = "Spline su tiesiais galais")
```


```{r}
gam.check(gam_model)
```


```{r}
AIC(spline_model, ns_model, gam_model)

```
